lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ham gaavahi har ham bolahi aur duteeaa preet ham tiaagee ||1||
lines.translation: I sing of the Lord, and I speak of the Lord; I have discarded all other loves. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamohan moro preetam raam har paramaana(n)d bairaagee ||
lines.translation: My Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; The Detached Lord God is the Embodiment of Supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੯॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: har dekhe jeevat hai naanak ik nimakh palo mukh laagee ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||
lines.translation: Nanak lives by gazing upon the Lord; may I see Him for a moment, for even just an instant. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag malaar mahalaa 5 chaupade ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa too sochahi kiaa too chitavahi kiaa too(n) karahi upaae ||
lines.translation: What are you so worried about? What are you thinking? What have you tried?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa kau kahahu paravaah kaahoo kee jih gopaal sahaae ||1||
lines.translation: Tell me - the Lord of the Universe - who controls Him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਸੈ ਮੇਘੁ ਸਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: barasai megh sakhee ghar paahun aae ||
lines.translation: The rain showers down from the clouds, O companion. The Guest has come into my home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi deen kripaa nidh thaakur nav nidh naam samaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am meek; my Lord and Master is the Ocean of Mercy. I am absorbed in the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik prakaar bhojan bahu keee bahu bi(n)jan misataae ||
lines.translation: I have prepared all sorts of foods in various ways, and all sorts of sweet deserts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: karee paakasaal soch pavitraa hun laavahu bhog har raae ||2||
lines.translation: I have made my kitchen pure and sacred. Now, O my Sovereign Lord King, please sample my food. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹਸੇ ਇਹਿ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਘਰ ਅਪਨਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusat bidaare saajan rahase ihi ma(n)dir ghar apanaae ||
lines.translation: The villains have been destroyed, and my friends are delighted. This is Your Own Mansion and Temple, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਓ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jau grihi laal ra(n)geeo aaiaa tau mai sabh sukh paae ||3||
lines.translation: When my Playful Beloved came into my household, then I found total peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sabhaa ot gur poore dhur masatak lekh likhaae ||
lines.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I have the Support and Protection of the Perfect Guru; this is the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ka(n)t ra(n)geelaa paaiaa phir dookh na laagai aae ||4||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has found his Playful Husband Lord. He shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kheer adhaar baarik jab hotaa bin kheerai rahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: When the baby's only food is milk, it cannot survive without its milk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਰੈ ਤਬ ਓਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saar samhaal maataa mukh neerai tab ohu tripat aghaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The mother takes care of it, and pours milk into its mouth; then, it is satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik pitaa prabh daataa ||
lines.translation: I am just a baby; God, the Great Giver, is my Father.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਅਨ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolahi baarik anik lakh bareeaa an thaur naahee jah jaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The child is so foolish; it makes so many mistakes. But it has nowhere else to go. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)chal mat baarik bapure kee sarap agan kar melai ||
lines.translation: The mind of the poor child is fickle; he touches even snakes and fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਬ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maataa pitaa ka(n)th laai raakhai anad sahaj tab khelai ||2||
lines.translation: His mother and father hug him close in their embrace, and so he plays in joy and bliss. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭੂਖ ਕੈਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kaa pitaa too hai mere suaamee tis baarik bhookh kaisee ||
lines.translation: What hunger can the child ever have, O my Lord and Master, when You are his Father?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੈਸੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nav nidh naam nidhaan grihi terai man baa(n)chhai so laisee ||3||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam and the nine treasures are in Your celestial household. You fulfill the desires of the mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਇਹ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pitaa kripaal aagiaa ih deenee baarik mukh maa(n)gai so denaa ||
lines.translation: My Merciful Father has issued this Command: whatever the child asks for, is put into his mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਾਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak baarik daras prabh chaahai mohi hridai basahi nit charanaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: Nanak, the child, longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. May His Feet always dwell within my heart. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧੀ ਜੁਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਤਜਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bidhee jur aahar kariaa tajio sagal a(n)desaa ||
lines.translation: I tried everything, and gathered all devices together; I have discarded all my anxieties.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਰੰਭਿਓ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੋਸਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaaraj sagal ara(n)bhio ghar kaa thaakur kaa bhaarosaa ||1||
lines.translation: I have begun to set all my household affairs right; I have placed my faith in my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਬਾਜੈ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: suneeai baajai baaj suhaavee ||
lines.translation: I listen to the celestial vibrations resonating and resounding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖ ਪੇਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਲਾਵੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhor bhaiaa mai pri mukh pekhe grihi ma(n)gal suhalaavee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sunrise has come, and I gaze upon the Face of my Beloved. My household is filled with peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa laai savaare thaanaa(n) poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
lines.translation: I focus my mind, and embellish and adorn the place within; then I go out to speak with the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat mai paahun milio bhagat karau niv paae ||2||
lines.translation: Seeking and searching, I have found my Husband Lord; I bow at His Feet and worship Him with devotion. ||2||
